author: KEXP
description:
Lagos-born trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Étuk Ubong weaves together afrobeats, highlife, jazz and the ritualistic drumming of Ekombi to create an urgent yet spiritual sonic atmosphere. 

Watch the full session and discover new music from our trip to @transmusicalesOfficiel  our channel.
title: Étuk Ubong performs "I See" ad more Live on KEXP from @transmusicalesOfficiel
